books.title: Short Fiction
books.author: Fritz Leiber
books.summary: A collection of Fritz Leiber short stories and novellas ordered by date of publication.

books.title: Allan Quatermain Stories
books.author: H. Rider Haggard
books.summary: A collection of short stories about a legendary hunter.

books.title: The Story of My Life
books.author: Helen Keller
books.summary: Helen Keller writes about her experiences as a deafblind child learning to communicate.

books.title: Tombstone
books.author: Walter Noble Burns
books.summary: An embellished retelling of the town of Tombstone, Arizona, during its heyday in the late 19th century, featuring famous heroes and outlaws of the American Old West.

books.title: The Voyages of Doctor Dolittle
books.author: Hugh Lofting
books.summary: A young boy begins his apprenticeship with Doctor Dolittle, accompanying him on a series of adventures in search of a floating island and a missing naturalist.

books.title: Psmith in the City
books.author: P. G. Wodehouse
books.summary: A young man abandons his dream of playing cricket at Cambridge because of financial trouble and goes to work for a London bank, where he’s joined by an unflappable friend.

books.title: Saint Joan
books.author: George Bernard Shaw
books.summary: Joan of Arc’s life story is retold, from her early life, to her campaigns, and beyond.

books.title: Domnei
books.author: James Branch Cabell
books.summary: The tale of to what extent a woman’s love is worth pursuing.

books.title: The Three Just Men
books.author: Edgar Wallace
books.summary: A group of recently-pardoned former vigilantes aids Scotland Yard in bringing a gang of thugs and murderers to justice.

books.title: Brood of the Witch-Queen
books.author: Sax Rohmer
books.summary: A father and son duo investigate a man who is wielding ancient Egyptian magic.

books.title: The Interesting Narrative of the Life of Olaudah Equiano
books.author: Olaudah Equiano
books.summary: An autobiography of an ex-slave in the mid 1700s.

books.title: The Patient in Room 18
books.author: Mignon G. Eberhart
books.summary: A nurse helps a detective investigate a murder in a hospital.

books.title: The Book of Tea
books.author: Okakura Kakuzō
books.summary: The Book of Tea is a long essay exploring the relationship between teaism, taoism, and the aesthetics of Japanese culture.

books.title: Nicomachean Ethics
books.author: Aristotle
books.summary: Aristotle examines how one may live in the most thriving, excellent manner.

books.title: Poetry
books.author: John Keats
books.summary: A collection of John Keats’ published poems, and a selection of unpublished fragments and posthumous verse.

books.title: Penguin Island
books.author: Anatole France
books.summary: A myopic saint mistakenly baptizes some penguins, ushering in a centuries-spanning satire of French history.

books.title: R.U.R.
books.author: Karel Čapek
books.summary: The development of artificial beings in huge quantities to act as workers and soldiers leads to disaster for mankind.

books.title: Short Fiction
books.author: H. Beam Piper
books.summary: A collection of science fiction stories by H. Beam Piper ordered by date of publication.

books.title: The Pilgrim Kamanita
books.author: Karl Gjellerup
books.summary: An Indian merchant’s son sets on a pilgrimage after a life of love, loss, business, and pleasure, and unknowingly relates his tale to the Buddha.

books.title: A Book-Lover’s Holidays in the Open
books.author: Theodore Roosevelt
books.summary: Outdoorsman and former U.S. president Theodore Roosevelt weaves his love of reading into the stories of his travels through the Americas.
